description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the Aws\S3\RegionalEndpoint namespace. It provides methods to create configuration providers for AWS S3 regional endpoints, including default, environment-based, ini file-based, and fallback providers. It also includes utility functions to unwrap configuration objects.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to generate configuration providers for AWS S3 regional endpoints, supporting various sources such as environment variables, ini files, and defaults. Implements a chainable pattern for composing multiple providers and includes caching and unwrapping functionalities.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Returns a provider that retrieves the AWS regional endpoint configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Returns a provider that loads configuration from a specified or default ini file, using a given profile.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Returns a provider with default fallback configuration options.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various configuration representations into a ConfigurationInterface object.
